 Why SEO reports frustrate people
 You cannot see what the fee is buying 
 1 What you have now
 You pay for SEO, or you have been quoted for it, and you cannot tell what you get each month. The report is a page of graphs that never mentions calls or enquiries.
 2 Why the map decides it
 When people in Basingstoke search for what you do, the map results take most of the clicks. If you sit outside the top three in your own postcodes, the calls go to the firms that do not.
 3 What Andy hands you
 One clear monthly report showing your map position across your areas, more reviews coming in without you remembering to ask, and a profile that stays current. A fixed monthly fee and a written scope.
 Every month
 What the fee covers, street by street 
 Five defined jobs make up the monthly work, so a Basingstoke client can hold the list up against the report. The map-rank grid sits at the centre, drawn over whichever streets and villages you actually serve.

 AI SEO and GEO
 The map shows where you rank. AI search is a separate question 
 Someone asking ChatGPT or Google's AI for a Basingstoke firm never sees a grid, so this is scoped as its own piece of work. AI SEO deals with Google and AI Overviews; GEO, or generative engine optimisation, deals with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. Both are priced to scope after a call. Nobody can guarantee a citation in an AI answer, and nothing can be promised about Google's AI answers.
 AI SEO
 Keyword and content strategy built around the questions buyers ask AI
 Pages structured so AI answers can quote them
 Technical foundations: speed, indexing, schema and internal linking
 Plain-English reporting on rankings, citations and enquiries
 GEO (generative engine optimisation)
 Key pages restructured into clear, quotable answers
 Structured data stating your services, prices, location and credentials
 AI crawler access and an llms.txt file
 Consistent business facts across the sources AI models read
 Monthly checks across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and AI Overviews
 Not on the list
 Four things Andy will not sell you 
 If another quote promises a ranking position on the Basingstoke map, ask how anyone could know that in advance. Andy cannot, so he leaves it out, along with the three other items below.

 The monthly report
 One grid, your position at every point 
 A map-rank grid answers one question: if someone searched from this exact spot, where would you appear? LocalFalcon lays a grid of points over the area you cover and records your Google Maps position at each one, which shows where a Basingstoke listing holds up and where it falls away.
 Map results change with the searcher's location. Ranking well from your own premises says very little about how you look from Chineham or Popley, and a single average number hides that.
 The summary that comes with the grid says in plain words what was done that month. If a position did not move, it says so.

 Before you book
 Questions about rankings and reports 
 How long does local SEO take in Basingstoke?
 Months, not weeks. How quickly it moves depends on your reviews and profile today, so that is what Andy looks at first.
 What is a map-rank grid?
 A set of points spread across the area you cover. At each point LocalFalcon records where your business appears in Google Maps for a chosen search, so you see your position street by street rather than as one average.
 Do I need a new website as well?
 Not always, because your Google profile and reviews do much of the work on the map. If the site itself is holding you back, Basingstoke website design is the same business, with builds from £600.
 Is there a contract?
 Terms are agreed in writing before work starts.
 What does GEO mean?
 Generative engine optimisation. It is the work of making your business easy for tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini to read and quote: clear answers on key pages, structured data and consistent business facts. It is priced to scope, and citations cannot be guaranteed.
 How does AI SEO relate to my map rankings?
 They overlap but they are measured differently. The grid records your Google Maps position from each point, while AI SEO looks at how Google and AI Overviews read your site and what they can quote from it. Improving one does not guarantee a change in the other.
 Are you an SEO agency in Basingstoke, or one person?
 One person. Antek Automation is a sole trader, so there is no account team between you and Andy, and he is based in Andover rather than in the town.
 What does local SEO in Basingstoke cost?
 From £497 a month. AI SEO and GEO are extra and priced to scope, and the citations clean-up add-on is priced per job.

Who runs your SEO
 Andy Norman, mapping Basingstoke search results 
 Before Antek Automation, Andy Norman worked for more than 30 years in field service and managed print, a trade where a customer's location is the whole job.
 Local search works on the same principle. A Basingstoke business does not have one ranking, it has a different one on every street, and Andy would rather show you all of them.
 How he handles an account
 Each month he runs the grid, keeps the profile current, handles the review requests and writes up what happened. You deal with him directly throughout.
